desc: Prove the structural equivalence between adjacent deletions and noncrossing matchings, including the parity-dependent unmatched element.
Prove the sorted-half formula for the maximum weighted noncrossing matching.
Validate the formula against samples and adversarial patterns, including alternating values, monotone orders, duplicates, and odd lengths.
Design the \(O(N\log N)\) Python implementation with safe integer arithmetic.
Prepare the correctness proof and complexity analysis.
